name: landing_public_mcp_server
description: Read-only public access to Landing's furnished apartment catalog: search by market and dates, fetch a home, check availability, get an anonymous quote. No authentication is required to call any tool. If your environment can't reach or speak MCP (no MCP client, or a GET-only sandbox that can't POST/JSON-RPC), use the plain HTTP GET REST API at https://www.hellolanding.com/api/public — it exposes the exact same read-only capabilities. See `alternatives.http-get`.
title: Landing Public MCP Server
